briefing.text: The Hunger Games prequel opened to about $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide.
GTA VI's record $3.79 billion launch still leads gaming, plus eight Game Awards nominations.
Mathematicians are checking a Claude-assisted Riemann Hypothesis proof; the code compiles.
Nvidia's board says Jensen Huang will not return, ahead of his December 1 House interview.
Attackers used a critical Cisco Expressway flaw to get into internal company networks.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel opened to an estimated $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide, AP reports.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: It took $56 million on Friday, including $21 million in previews, and made up about 72% of all weekend ticket sales. Audiences gave it an A- CinemaScore, up from B+ for the last prequel.
stories.next: Watch for how well it holds over the Thanksgiving holiday week.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It beat Lionsgate's own $85 million weekend forecast.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It was about 2.7 times the opening of The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened the week before Thanksgiving, a strong window for long runs.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: A film about a deadly televised contest
meme.bottom: is winning its own contest
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas, which are once again fighting to survive the weekend.

stories.title: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, Rockstar says
stories.summary: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in first-day worldwide retail sales, and 32.5 million copies were pre-sold.
stories.why: It is one of the biggest entertainment launches ever, and a test for the whole console market.
stories.happened: Take-Two estimates it took $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, the biggest entertainment launch yet. It came out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S and leads The Game Awards with eight nominations.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's next sales update and The Game Awards on December 10.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The day-one figure beats GTA V's launch several times over.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans waited 13 years since GTA V.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its 99 on Metacritic ties the highest score the site lists.

stories.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two Interactive and also made Red Dead Redemption.

meme.bottom: for a game about doing crimes for money
meme.take: GTA VI earns in one day what its characters spend a whole campaign trying to steal.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with help from Claude, Bloomberg reports.
stories.why: The Riemann Hypothesis is one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics, so a proof would be historic.
stories.happened: Levent Alpöge published a computer-checkable proof claim. Independent mathematicians have compiled the Lean code but are still checking whether its formal statement matches the real hypothesis, The Neuron reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether reviewers agree the formal statement captures the actual Riemann Hypothesis.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI-assisted proof of a problem this famous would be a first.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is one of the Clay Institute's million-dollar Millennium Prize Problems.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The formal proof is reported at about 17 million lines.

stories.background: Posed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the zeros of the zeta function, which are tied to how primes are spread.

meme.bottom: the mathematicians do not, yet
meme.take: The code checks out. Now the humans have to check what the code was actually about.

stories.title: Nvidia opens a CEO search as its board rules out Jensen Huang's return
stories.summary: Nvidia's board has hired Heidrick & Struggles to find a new CEO and says it does not plan to reinstate Huang, after shares fell 14% on Friday.
stories.why: Nvidia's chips power most of the AI boom, so turmoil there affects the whole industry.
stories.happened: Huang posted on November 17 that he would be honoured to return, but board chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate him. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Shares closed at $125.53 on November 20.
stories.next: Watch for Huang's December 1 House committee interview and any news from the CEO search.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Shares sit about 48% below their October record.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Huang co-founded Nvidia and led it for over 30 years.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Several regulators are looking at the company.

stories.background: Nvidia makes the GPUs behind most AI models. Finance chief Colette Kress is interim CEO after Huang resigned in November.

meme.bottom: the founder applied
meme.take: Nvidia's former CEO says he would come back, and the board has said no thank you.

stories.title: Questions grow over Anthropic's IPO as its shares keep sliding
stories.summary: The FT asks whether Anthropic and its bankers got the IPO wrong, after weak trading and a quick use of the option to sell extra shares.
stories.why: The listing is the first big test of how public markets value a frontier AI company.
stories.happened: Shares priced at $83 opened at $111.50 and fell about 9% on day two. Reuters reports Anthropic limited some of its 22 underwriters to four senior bankers and sought six-month limits on their work with AI rivals.
stories.next: Watch for how the shares trade this week and the December 15 lock-up release.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It was described as the largest US listing on record.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Some bankers reportedly chafed at the unusual limits on deal teams.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The slide comes during a wider tech sell-off.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. It listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

meme.top: The IPO had strict rules for bankers
meme.bottom: and none for the share price
meme.take: Anthropic controlled who worked on its IPO, but not who sold afterwards.

stories.title: Startup says AI agents designed a whole new CPU architecture
stories.summary: Architect Labs says AI agents designed Frostbite, a processor with a new instruction set, which it says beat a conventional core on efficiency in simulation.
stories.why: Chip design takes large teams years, so AI doing much of it would change how processors are made.
stories.happened: The company reports 4.59 times the performance per watt of a similar in-order CPU across 25 simulated workloads, and 3.83 times without AI-specific tuning. The 7 nm design has not been built as a chip.
stories.next: Watch for a physical test chip and independent benchmarks.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A full CPU architecture designed by AI agents would be new.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The claimed efficiency gain is over four times.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Results come from simulation, not real silicon.

stories.background: A CPU's instruction set is the basic language of commands it understands. New ones are rare because software must be rebuilt for them.

meme.top: AI agents designed a new processor
meme.bottom: for future AI agents to run on
meme.take: AI has started designing its own hardware, which is one way to skip the job interview.

stories.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
stories.summary: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.
stories.why: Netflix rarely puts its films in big-screen cinemas, so a run like this draws attention.
stories.happened: Occupy Cinema lists the IMAX run starting on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving. AP also describes it as a Netflix IMAX release over the holiday corridor.
stories.next: Watch for its IMAX box office over the holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens on the busiest moviegoing week of autumn.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Netflix theatrical runs in IMAX are unusual.

stories.background: Cliff Booth was Brad Pitt's stuntman character in the 2019 film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

meme.top: A Netflix film is in cinemas
meme.bottom: for exactly as long as it takes
meme.take: Netflix gives Cliff Booth two weeks on the big screen, then the usual couch residency.

stories.title: Cisco Expressway flaw exploited to break into internal networks
stories.summary: Attackers used a critical Cisco Expressway flaw, CVE-2026-76466, to get root access on devices and move into internal networks, Help Net Security reports.
stories.why: Expressway handles video calls at the edge of many company networks, so a flaw there opens the door inside.
stories.happened: Security firm F6 says attackers took over two internet-facing devices, then reached two internal cluster nodes. CISA added the flaw to its exploited list on November 20. Cisco's fix is version X15.5.20.
stories.next: Watch for further victims and how quickly organisations apply the patch.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It gives an unauthenticated attacker root access.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Expressway is used widely for business video calls.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: CISA has told US agencies to patch.

stories.background: CISA, the US cybersecurity agency, keeps a list of flaws known to be exploited and sets patch deadlines for agencies.

meme.top: A device built to keep calls secure
meme.bottom: let the callers in
meme.take: Cisco's video gateway was a little too welcoming to uninvited guests.

stories.title: Trump and Xi agreed humans should stay in military AI decisions, Bessent says
stories.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the two leaders agreed that humans should stay involved in major military decisions that use AI.
stories.why: The US and China are the two biggest AI powers, so any shared limit on military AI is significant.
stories.happened: Reuters reported Bessent's comments on November 20. Semafor reports interest in joint US-China AI guardrails even as Washington restricts chip exports. No implementation details have been set.
stories.next: Watch for any written agreement or follow-up talks on how the principle would be applied.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It involves the leaders of the world's two largest economies.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Autonomous weapons are one of the most debated uses of AI.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Shared US-China AI guardrails have been rare.

stories.background: The US has limited exports of advanced AI chips to China for several years, citing national security.

meme.bottom: that someone should be in charge of it
meme.take: The US and China found common ground on AI, which is that a person should press the button.

stories.title: TSMC and Samsung reportedly pause some chip shipments to China
stories.summary: TrendForce reports TSMC and Samsung have suspended some chip shipments to Chinese customers after tighter US export rules.
stories.why: The pause could reach everyday electronics, not just AI processors.
stories.happened: TrendForce says the impact could extend to consumer electronics and some 16nm orders. Impact Newswire separately reports TSMC suspended some approved advanced-chip orders from Chinese designers. Neither firm has confirmed it.
stories.next: Watch for statements from TSMC or Samsung and any clarification of the US rules.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: TSMC and Samsung make most of the world's advanced chips.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Supply gaps could raise device prices.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Chips are central to US-China tech competition.

stories.background: TSMC in Taiwan is the world's largest contract chipmaker. Samsung is the other major maker of advanced chips.

meme.top: New rules on chips to China
meme.bottom: now covering the boring chips too
meme.take: Export controls have moved from AI processors to the parts in your microwave.

stories.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
stories.summary: The eight-episode Blade Runner series, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, streams on Prime Video from November 25.
stories.why: It continues one of science fiction's most influential film series on television.
stories.happened: BillFrost.tv says the series, created by Silka Luisa, had been stuck in development since 2024. TVLine also lists all episodes for November 25.
stories.next: Watch for reviews once all the episodes are out.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Blade Runner (1982) is a cult science fiction classic.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Michelle Yeoh leads the cast.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: All episodes drop just before the holiday weekend.

stories.background: Blade Runner is Ridley Scott's 1982 film based on a Philip K. Dick novel. A sequel, Blade Runner 2049, followed in 2017.

meme.top: A show about spotting the machines
meme.bottom: arrives in the year of AI
meme.take: Blade Runner 2099 lands just as the question it asks has become an everyday chore.

stories.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops to $499 for Black Friday
stories.summary: Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 below its $549 price, for a limited time.
stories.why: It is one of the first real price cuts on Nintendo's new console in its first holiday season.
stories.happened: Nintendo Wire calls it one of the biggest Switch 2 deals yet. Walmart is also listing Mario Galaxy 1 and 2, Donkey Kong Bananza and other Nintendo games at $30 each, My Nintendo News reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether stock lasts through Black Friday weekend.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It is $50 off the bundle's usual price.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Black Friday is the biggest console sales week.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Mario Kart is among Nintendo's best-selling series.

stories.background: The Switch 2 is Nintendo's latest console, the follow-up to the 2017 Switch.

meme.bottom: the shells are still full price
meme.take: Black Friday takes $50 off Mario Kart, which will be lost to a blue shell by Saturday.

stories.title: Optimizely supply-chain attack put a card skimmer on 178 brands' sites
stories.summary: Malicious code in Optimizely's JavaScript ran on 178 brands' websites on November 16, skimming card data and swapping crypto addresses, reports say.
stories.why: One compromised supplier script can reach shoppers on many big sites at once, days before Black Friday.
stories.happened: The Layman Security, citing Report URI's research, says the code targeted iPhone users, skimmed payment card data and replaced crypto wallet addresses. It ran through Optimizely's experiment scripts.
stories.next: Watch for the list of affected brands and notices to shoppers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 178 brands were affected.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit just before the biggest online shopping week.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers target shared scripts to reach many sites.

stories.background: Optimizely makes tools that let websites test different page designs, using scripts loaded on customers' sites.

meme.bottom: someone tested a very bad one
meme.take: Optimizely's script ran an experiment on 178 brands. The control group was your card.

stories.title: SpaceX's $74 billion AI data-centre plans raise questions over power bills
stories.summary: Fortune reports SpaceX has about $74 billion of AI facilities planned in Texas and Arizona, and locals want to know who pays for the grid.
stories.why: Big AI data centres need huge amounts of electricity, and households worry about higher bills.
stories.happened: Fortune says the Arizona campus alone implies about 6 gigawatts of demand when fully built. Residents and officials want proof the developer, not local ratepayers, will cover grid costs.
stories.next: Watch for utility agreements or rulings on who pays for new power lines.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 6 gigawatts is a city-sized amount of power.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The planned spending is about $74 billion.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Grid upgrades can end up on household bills.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket and satellite company. Data centres for AI run thousands of power-hungry chips at once.

meme.bottom: residents want to see the bill first
meme.take: SpaceX can land rockets on a barge, but the hard part is a town hall about electricity rates.

stories.title: Disney's animated Hexed leads the Thanksgiving week cinema openings
stories.summary: Disney's Hexed opens wide on November 25, alongside Hershey, Bitter Christmas and A24's Club Kid, with Focker In-Law following on November 27.
stories.why: Thanksgiving is one of the biggest moviegoing weeks of the year, and family films usually lead it.
stories.happened: Occupy Cinema, citing Box Office Mojo's calendar, lists Hexed from Disney, Hershey from Angel Studios and Bitter Christmas from Sony Pictures Classics for Wednesday. AP lists Universal's Focker In-Law for Friday.
stories.next: Watch for the five-day holiday totals and how Hexed fares against the Hunger Games prequel.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Thanksgiving week is a traditional window for family films.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: New openers face the Hunger Games prequel in its second week.

stories.background: Disney animation has often released films over Thanksgiving, including Frozen in 2013.

meme.top: Disney opens a film called Hexed
meme.bottom: on a week of family gatherings
meme.take: Hexed arrives on Thanksgiving, a holiday with plenty of family curses already.

stories.title: AI-led sell-off deepens, dragging Bitcoin to a 20-week low near $60,000
stories.summary: After the Nasdaq's 5.28% fall on November 20, the tech sell-off has spread, with Bitcoin dropping to about $60,000, TechJuice reports.
stories.why: Many savers and retirement funds hold the big tech stocks that have led markets for years.
stories.happened: The Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow had their worst week since April 2025. TechJuice ties Bitcoin's slide to doubts about AI firms after Anthropic's share reversal. UBS still expects AI investment of $1.4 trillion in 2027.
stories.next: Watch for whether tech shares steady this week as investors debate if AI spending has peaked.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The Nasdaq erased its 2026 gain in one session.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Investors are questioning whether AI spending will pay off.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: The selling has spread from tech stocks to crypto.

stories.background: A correction means a fall of 10% or more from a recent high. The Nasdaq is heavy with tech companies.

meme.top: The AI trade had a bad week
meme.bottom: Bitcoin offered moral support
meme.take: The AI sell-off spread to crypto, proving diversification is mostly a state of mind.

stories.title: Meta reconsiders its 2030 net-zero goal as AI pushes emissions up
stories.summary: Meta says it is re-evaluating its net-zero milestones as its AI infrastructure grows, Ars Technica reports.
stories.why: Big tech firms promised to cut emissions, and AI is testing whether those promises hold.
stories.happened: Meta's reported total emissions rose from 15.6 million metric tons of CO2 equivalent in 2024 to more than 21.7 million in 2025, roughly 40% higher. It had aimed for net zero across its value chain by 2030.
stories.next: Watch for whether Meta sets a new target date or changes how it counts emissions.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Emissions rose about 40% in one year.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI data centres are driving up energy use across big tech.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta is one of the largest AI spenders.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and is building large data centres for its AI models.

meme.bottom: AI had other plans
meme.take: Meta is rethinking net zero, having found a technology that is very good at the opposite.

stories.title: Steam Awards add a Hall of Fame vote between ten past Games of the Year
stories.summary: Nominations for the tenth Steam Awards run until November 30, with a new Hall of Fame pitting past winners against each other.
stories.why: It turns ten years of Steam's top games into one fan vote, which invites argument.
stories.happened: PC Gamer says the Hall of Fame includes GTA V, The Witcher 3, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3 and Hollow Knight: Silksong. Three new categories were added, and voting starts with the Steam Winter Sale on December 17.
stories.next: Watch for the finalists when voting opens on December 17.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Ten years of winners compete at once.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Fans of Elden Ring and Baldur's Gate 3 will want their pick to win.

stories.background: The Steam Awards are fan-voted prizes run by Valve on its Steam PC store each year since 2016.

meme.bottom: one of them is about to lose
meme.take: Valve asked fans to rank ten masterpieces, which is a fine way to end a friendship.

stats.label: past winners in Hall of Fame

stories.title: VMware vCenter zero-day was used for months before Broadcom's patch
stories.summary: Mandiant says a group it calls ARMORY CASTLE used vCenter flaw CVE-2026-123890 from September to make itself a sign-in administrator.
stories.why: vCenter runs the virtual servers behind many company data centres, so admin access there is very powerful.
stories.happened: The flaw is rated 9.8 out of 10. Broadcom patched it on November 19 and CISA added it to its exploited list. Help Net Security says the suspected group is linked to espionage.
stories.next: Watch for further victim disclosures and CISA's patch deadline.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It gave attackers top-level control of virtual servers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: vCenter is used across large enterprises.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was exploited for months before a fix.

stories.background: VMware, owned by Broadcom, makes vSphere and vCenter, software used to run many virtual machines on shared hardware.

meme.bottom: and nobody asked for ID
meme.take: The vCenter flaw handed out admin rights with the care of a free sample stand.

stories.title: I Play Rocky takes second with $9.3 million in its wide expansion
stories.summary: Peter Farrelly's film about the making of Rocky expanded from 29 to 2,477 cinemas and took second with $9.3 million, AP reports.
stories.why: A crowd-pleasing film about making Rocky could become counter-programming to the Hunger Games prequel.
stories.happened: Audiences gave it a rare A+ CinemaScore, the same grade as Farrelly's Green Book. AP calls it a potential Oscar contender. Anthony Ippolito plays a young Sylvester Stallone.
stories.next: Watch for whether word of mouth carries it through Thanksgiving.

drivers.label: Word of mouth
drivers.text: An A+ CinemaScore is rare.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Rocky is one of cinema's best-known underdog stories.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It expanded against the Hunger Games prequel.

stories.background: Rocky (1976) was written by and starred Sylvester Stallone and won the Oscar for best picture.

meme.bottom: finished second, as underdogs do
meme.take: I Play Rocky took second place, which is the most Rocky result possible.

stories.title: Customer-service AI startup Sierra is reported to raise $1.75 billion
stories.summary: Sierra, which makes AI agents for customer service, has reportedly raised $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation.
stories.why: It shows investors still pay big prices for AI agents even as AI stocks wobble.
stories.happened: Wowtale reports the round values Sierra at $30 billion. The company says its annual recurring revenue has passed $400 million.
stories.next: Watch for confirmation of the investors and how Sierra plans to spend the money.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $30 billion valuation puts it among the largest private AI firms.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Companies are moving support work to AI agents.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The raise comes during an AI stock sell-off.

stories.background: Sierra builds AI agents that answer customer questions for businesses.

meme.top: The stock market is nervous about AI
meme.bottom: private investors did not get the memo
meme.take: Public markets are selling AI while private ones keep buying it at full price.

stories.title: GTA VI gets its first big patch, 1.002.002, with no patch notes
stories.summary: Rockstar's update 1.002.002 is rolling out by region, at about 600MB on PS5, but no patch notes have been published, PlayStation LifeStyle reports.
stories.why: Millions of new players want to know what a first patch fixes in a game this big.
stories.happened: Xbox players report a 1.2 to 1.6GB download. Some players say the game runs more smoothly, which the outlet says could be placebo. It also says a money glitch still works for some players.
stories.next: Watch for Rockstar's own notes on what the update changed.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA VI is the biggest launch of the year.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are tracking every change after release.

stories.background: Rockstar often releases console patches without detailed public notes.

meme.bottom: and told no one what it does
meme.take: GTA VI's first patch arrives with no notes, so players are reviewing it by vibes.

stories.title: iPhone Air 2 dummy units point to a new dual-camera design
stories.summary: Dummy models said to show the iPhone Air 2 have a dual rear camera, while the standard iPhone 18 looks largely unchanged, reports say.
stories.why: The first iPhone Air was criticised for having one rear camera, so a second lens would answer that.
stories.happened: 9to5Mac reports the dummy units show a new dual-camera layout. MacTech, citing MacRumors, says the standard iPhone 18 dummies look largely unchanged. Apple has announced nothing.
stories.next: Watch for further leaks and Apple's reported early-2027 launch plans.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: New iPhone designs always draw attention.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The single camera was a common complaint about the first Air.

stories.background: Dummy units are non-working models often made for case makers ahead of a launch. They are not always accurate.

meme.top: The thinnest iPhone got a second camera
meme.bottom: it will still not fit in the case
meme.take: Apple's skinniest phone is reportedly bulking up, one lens at a time.

stories.title: The Rings of Power season 3 finale lands on Prime Video on November 24
stories.summary: Amazon's Lord of the Rings series ends its third season with two episodes at 9 p.m. on November 24, TVLine's schedule lists.
stories.why: It is one of the most expensive TV series ever made, so its future is watched closely.
stories.happened: TVLine lists the two-episode finale among the week's biggest TV events. Blade Runner 2099 arrives on the same service the next day.
stories.next: Watch for news on whether Amazon orders a fourth season.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It is among the costliest TV series ever made.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Tolkien's world has a huge global fanbase.

stories.background: The series is set thousands of years before The Lord of the Rings and draws on J.R.R. Tolkien's writings.

meme.bottom: the budget remains the real dragon
meme.take: The Rings of Power ends season three, with its most powerful ring still the budget.

stories.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard confirm vendor breaches after n0n leak claim
stories.summary: The three firms have confirmed breaches at vendors after the n0n group's leak claim, with names and emails exposed, The Layman Security reports.
stories.why: Data linked to three of the biggest names in payments can fuel convincing phishing scams against customers.
stories.happened: The Layman Security says the exposed data was names and email addresses, not card numbers. Reuters earlier reported leaked JPMorgan records with over 16,000 customer emails, which it could not verify.
stories.next: Watch for official customer notifications and any confirmed count of people affected.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It involves three of the largest payment and banking firms.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Leaked names and emails are often used for phishing.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers increasingly go after vendors instead of the main company.

stories.background: Supply-chain breaches happen when attackers reach a company's data through a supplier or contractor.

meme.bottom: and got the marketing list
meme.take: Breach shows even bank vaults are only as strong as the newsletter vendor.

stories.title: Java4Shell flaw lets a crafted text string take over some Java servers
stories.summary: CVE-2026-114938 lets a crafted Base64 string corrupt Java's memory on servers with AVX-512 chips, which can lead to code execution.
stories.why: Java runs huge amounts of business software, including tools like Jenkins, Jira and Tomcat.
stories.happened: Oracle fixed the flaw on November 17, and CISA has urged organisations to patch, The Layman Security reports. Horizon3.ai published the research.
stories.next: Watch for signs of active exploitation and vendor updates for Java-based products.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Java is one of the most widely used server platforms.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The name recalls 2021's Log4Shell crisis.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It can lead to remote code execution.

stories.background: AVX-512 is a set of fast maths instructions on many Intel and AMD server processors.

meme.bottom: can now run your server
meme.take: Java4Shell shows that the most dangerous thing on a server is still a well-chosen sentence.

stories.title: OpenRouter drops three AI providers after researchers find stolen keys
stories.summary: OpenRouter removed three inference providers and 125 endpoints from its zero-data-retention list after Dragos found compromised providers.
stories.why: Developers often send private data through cheap AI providers without knowing who runs them.
stories.happened: Dragos sent about two million fake AI requests and found at least three compromised providers and hundreds of stolen AWS keys, The Decoder reports. It says some cheap hosts could snoop on users.
stories.next: Watch for which providers are named and whether other AI routers tighten their checks.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: User prompts may have been seen by unknown parties.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Researchers sent two million test requests.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI supply chains are a new target for attackers.

stories.background: OpenRouter lets developers reach many AI models from different providers through a single API.

meme.top: The budget AI host kept no data
meme.bottom: it simply shared it
meme.take: Some cheap AI hosts offered zero data retention and generous data distribution.

stories.title: You Can See Everything comes to digital rental after a near-$100 million run
stories.summary: Nathan Fielder's documentary arrives to rent or buy on November 24 while still in cinemas, where it made $2.5 million last weekend.
stories.why: Documentaries almost never reach blockbuster numbers, so a hit this size stands out.
stories.happened: BillFrost.tv lists the digital premiere for November 24 and puts the film's box office near $99 million. AP had it sixth at the weekend box office with $2.5 million.
stories.next: Watch for how it charts on digital rental lists over the holiday week.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It has earned about 14 times its reported budget.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Very few documentaries have passed $100 million.

stories.background: Most documentaries open in a small number of cinemas or go straight to streaming.

meme.bottom: now you can pause it
meme.take: You Can See Everything is coming home, where you can finally see everything twice.

stories.title: Cleverbridge says hackers copied card numbers and CVVs from its platform
stories.summary: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge, whose clients include Red Hat and Sony, says a third party copied stored payment card data, including CVVs.
stories.why: Card numbers with security codes can be used for fraud, so buyers may need new cards.
stories.happened: It detected the activity on November 4 and began notifying customers on November 20. A notice seen by BleepingComputer says card numbers, expiry dates and CVVs were copied, but not names or billing details.
stories.next: Watch for the number of affected customers and which software brands' buyers were hit.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its clients include Red Hat, Sony and Veeam.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Full card details are enough for online fraud.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes just before Black Friday shopping.

stories.background: Cleverbridge handles online payments for software and subscription companies.

meme.bottom: the one number meant to be forgotten
meme.take: Cleverbridge learned the three digits on the back are meant to be forgotten, not filed.

stories.title: OpenAI suggests next-word prediction as a shared measure of AI progress
stories.summary: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published internal perplexity results and proposed it as a common yardstick across AI labs.
stories.why: Labs disagree on how to measure progress, and benchmarks are often gamed or quickly outdated.
stories.happened: OpenAI argued that how well a model predicts the next token can track progress across labs. The Neuron notes that this alone cannot show how a model behaves on every real task.
stories.next: Watch for whether other labs publish comparable numbers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The proposal comes from OpenAI's chief scientist.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: A shared metric would make labs easier to compare.

stories.background: Perplexity measures how surprised a language model is by real text; lower is better.

meme.top: OpenAI proposed a way to measure AI
meme.bottom: the measure is guessing the next word
meme.take: OpenAI wants to grade AI on predicting the next word, which explains a lot of meetings.

stories.title: Peter Berg's football drama The Mosquito Bowl premieres on Netflix
stories.summary: The Mosquito Bowl, a football drama set after Pearl Harbor, premieres on Netflix on November 25.
stories.why: A sports film arriving the day before Thanksgiving football fits the holiday viewing mood.
stories.happened: TVLine lists Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgard, Ray Nicholson and Tom Francis in the cast. BillFrost.tv says Peter Berg directs.
stories.next: Watch for whether it reaches Netflix's top ten over the holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands just before Thanksgiving football.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Peter Berg directed Friday Night Lights.

stories.background: Peter Berg is a director known for Friday Night Lights and Lone Survivor.

meme.bottom: released the day before the big games
meme.take: Netflix found the one thing to watch on Thanksgiving that is also football.

stories.title: GTA VI players find a Super Mario nod with brick breaking and hats
stories.summary: A player's video reportedly shows a GTA VI hallucination scene that references Super Mario, including brick breaking and wearable hats.
stories.why: Easter egg hunts keep a big game in the conversation weeks after launch.
stories.happened: Nintendo Wire reports a YouTube user shared footage of Jason Duval hallucinating near some ruins in a scene that echoes Super Mario. Rockstar has not commented on the reference.
stories.next: Watch for more hidden references as players explore the map.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Mario is gaming's most famous character.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are hunting secrets across the new map.

stories.background: Rockstar games are known for hidden jokes and references to pop culture.

meme.top: The most adult game of the year
meme.bottom: has a Mario tribute
meme.take: GTA VI hides a Mario reference, proving even Vice City respects the plumber.

stories.title: Peacock's DIG, with Amy Poehler as an archaeologist, is out in full
stories.summary: All ten episodes of DIG, from Amy Poehler and Michael Schur, arrived on Peacock on November 23.
stories.why: A new Amy Poehler series is a draw for fans of her comedy work.
stories.happened: Poehler plays an archaeologist on a dig site in Greece, with Hugh Laurie and Geraldine Viswanathan co-starring, BillFrost.tv reports. Jason Mantzoukas and Max Greenfield guest star.
stories.next: Watch for reviews and Peacock's viewing figures.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amy Poehler and Michael Schur made Parks and Recreation together.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands as viewers settle in for Thanksgiving week.

stories.background: Amy Poehler starred in Parks and Recreation and was a Saturday Night Live cast member.

meme.top: A comedy about digging up the past
meme.bottom: from the people who made Parks and Rec
meme.take: Peacock drops all of DIG at once, trusting you to have no plans for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: NGINX fixes five critical flaws, including an HTTP/2 bug from 2015
stories.summary: NGINX patched five code-execution flaws rated 9.2 on November 18, and one HTTP/2 bug now has a public proof-of-concept exploit.
stories.why: NGINX powers a large share of the world's websites, so a public exploit raises the pressure to patch.
stories.happened: The HTTP/2 bug, CVE-2026-123007, dates back to 2015, The Layman Security reports, citing Rapid7. All five flaws are rated 9.2 out of 10.
stories.next: Watch for reports of attacks using the public exploit.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: NGINX runs a large share of web servers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Public exploit code makes attacks easier.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The oldest bug went unnoticed for about 11 years.

stories.background: NGINX is open-source web server software, now owned by F5, used to serve and balance traffic for websites.

meme.bottom: finally got noticed
meme.take: NGINX fixed a flaw old enough to have outlived several of the frameworks it served.

stories.title: Microsoft says an Entra Connect Health flaw was used to take tenant data
stories.summary: Microsoft has disclosed that attackers exploited a flaw in its Entra Connect Health API to reach tenant metadata, including admin emails, reports say.
stories.why: Entra is how many companies sign staff into Microsoft 365, so flaws there draw close attention.
stories.happened: BleepingComputer reports the flaw was exploited to steal tenant data. Several outlets report the exposed data included tenant metadata and administrator email addresses.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's guidance to admins and the number of tenants affected.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Microsoft's identity service is used by a huge number of businesses.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Admin emails are valuable for targeted phishing.

stories.background: Microsoft Entra, formerly Azure Active Directory, manages sign-in and identity for businesses.

meme.bottom: was the one that needed a check-up
meme.take: Microsoft's Connect Health tool turned out to be the patient.

stories.title: The Hunting Wives season 2 arrives on Netflix on Thanksgiving Day
stories.summary: All eight episodes of The Hunting Wives season 2, with Brittany Snow and Malin Akerman, stream on Netflix on November 26.
stories.why: Its first season became a streaming talking point, so a holiday binge release is a big draw.
stories.happened: BillFrost.tv and TVLine both list all eight episodes for Thanksgiving. BillFrost.tv notes the first season was originally made for Starz.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops Netflix's TV chart over the weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Holiday binge releases tend to draw big audiences.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The first season built a loyal following.

stories.background: The Hunting Wives is a drama thriller based on a novel by May Cobb.

meme.top: A drama about secrets and family
meme.bottom: released on Thanksgiving
meme.take: Netflix scheduled a show about tense social gatherings for the year's tensest dinner.

stories.title: Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior, with Arkheron on day one
stories.summary: Xbox Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and Arkheron launches in Game Preview on November 27.
stories.why: Game Pass additions decide what millions of subscribers try over the holiday.
stories.happened: PlayStationInfo says Arkheron is a three-player team game where found gear, not a fixed class, sets how you play. Eight games leave the service on November 30.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's December Game Pass line-up.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: New games land over Thanksgiving weekend.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Day-one launches on Game Pass are a key Xbox selling point.

stories.background: Xbox Game Pass is Microsoft's subscription that gives access to a rotating library of games.

meme.top: Eight games are leaving Game Pass
meme.bottom: your backlog remains
meme.take: Game Pass adds three games and removes eight, which is still more than most of us finish.

stories.title: Persona 6 has no date, but a website update fuels Game Awards trailer talk
stories.summary: Atlus says Persona 6 has no release date yet, while an update to its web domain has fans expecting a trailer at The Game Awards on December 10.
stories.why: Persona is one of the most popular Japanese role-playing series, and fans have waited years for a new main entry.
stories.happened: Nintendo Life reports Atlus also said the wait for Persona 7 will be shorter. MyNintendoNews notes a Persona 4 Revival domain update came a month before its trailer. Nothing has been announced.
stories.next: Watch for The Game Awards on December 10 and any teasers from Atlus before then.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Persona 5 came out in 2016 in Japan.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Awards are under three weeks away.

stories.background: Atlus is a Japanese studio owned by Sega that makes the Persona and Shin Megami Tensei series.

meme.bottom: a whole fandom cleared its December
meme.take: Persona fans have turned domain records into the most closely read documents in gaming.

stories.title: Nintendo's winter catalogue gives a first glimpse of Pokemon Winds and Waves
stories.summary: Nintendo's Japanese Winter Catalogue includes a short description of Pokemon Winds and Waves, promising islands and a vast ocean to explore.
stories.why: Any detail about a new main Pokemon game gets picked apart by one of the biggest fan bases in gaming.
stories.happened: MyNintendoNews says the text talks about overcoming paths and forces of nature with Pokemon. The catalogue also showed Samus's suit in Metroid Ravenous. A separate rumour claims an overhauled turn-based battle system.
stories.next: Watch for an official trailer or release window from The Pokemon Company.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pokemon is the highest-earning media franchise in the world.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Sea and island settings echo earlier fan-favourite games.

stories.background: Pokemon games are made by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokemon Company.

meme.bottom: ten thousand theories
meme.take: Nintendo released two sentences about Pokemon and the fans have already written the sequel.

stories.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation has been rated by the ESRB
stories.summary: The third part of the Final Fantasy VII remake series has received an ESRB rating, My Nintendo News reports.
stories.why: Ratings often come shortly before a release date or marketing push, so fans watch for them.
stories.happened: My Nintendo News reported the rating on November 23. The game is also nominated for Most Anticipated Game at The Game Awards, Push Square lists.
stories.next: Watch for a release date, possibly at The Game Awards on December 10.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Final Fantasy VII is one of the best-loved role-playing games.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Awards are just over two weeks away.

stories.background: Square Enix has been remaking the 1997 Final Fantasy VII as a trilogy of games since 2020.

meme.top: Final Fantasy VII got a rating
meme.bottom: fans now have a reason to refresh
meme.take: An age rating was filed, and Final Fantasy fans read it like a release date.

stories.title: Elastic agrees to buy AI agent tracing startup HoneyHive
stories.summary: Elastic has agreed to acquire HoneyHive, which makes tools for tracing and evaluating AI agents. Terms were not disclosed.
stories.why: As firms deploy AI agents, they need ways to see what those agents are actually doing.
stories.happened: Dealroom reports the deal alongside other AI control and monitoring investments. HoneyHive's tools record and score how AI agents behave in production.
stories.next: Watch for how Elastic builds HoneyHive into its observability products.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Monitoring AI agents is becoming its own market.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Security and data firms are buying AI tooling startups.

stories.background: Elastic makes Elasticsearch, widely used for search, logging and monitoring software systems.

meme.bottom: now they are buying the cameras
meme.take: Elastic bought a startup that watches AI agents, because trust is easier with logs.

stories.title: Ebenezer drops 60% in its second weekend but passes $78 million worldwide
stories.summary: Johnny Depp's Christmas film made $7.7 million in its second weekend, down about 60%, and has $32.5 million in the US, AP reports.
stories.why: Holiday films often make most of their money in December, so an early drop matters.
stories.happened: It was last week's No. 1 film and fell to third behind the Hunger Games prequel and I Play Rocky. AP puts its international total at $45.9 million.
stories.next: Watch for its hold over Thanksgiving week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Johnny Depp plays the lead.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Christmas stories usually play through December.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces the Hunger Games and I Play Rocky this weekend.

stories.background: Ebenezer is a new take on Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

meme.bottom: then the Hunger Games
meme.take: Ebenezer survived the spirits of Christmas but not the spirit of franchise season.

stories.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is set for November 29 on the original Switch
stories.summary: Telltale's remaster of The Wolf Among Us has an eShop date of November 29 on the original Switch, after an earlier delay.
stories.why: The 2013 game is a fan favourite, and its sequel has been long awaited.
stories.happened: My Nintendo News spotted the date on the eShop listing. Nintendo Life had reported in October that the remaster was delayed.
stories.next: Watch for versions on other platforms and news on the sequel.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original came out in 2013.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands on Thanksgiving weekend.

stories.background: The Wolf Among Us is a Telltale adventure game based on the Fables comics.

meme.bottom: arrives on a 2017 console
meme.take: The Wolf Among Us gets remastered for a console that is now a classic itself.

stories.title: The full Mario Kart DS soundtrack is now on Nintendo Music
stories.summary: Nintendo has added all 78 tracks of the Mario Kart DS soundtrack to its Nintendo Music app for Switch Online members.
stories.why: Game music has a big following, and Mario Kart DS is a favourite for many players who grew up with it.
stories.happened: Nintendo Wire says the soundtrack was uploaded on the night of November 19. Nintendo adds new soundtracks to the app each month.
stories.next: Watch for the next soundtracks Nintendo adds in December.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Mario Kart DS came out in 2005.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have long asked for official game music streaming.

stories.background: Nintendo Music is an app that lets Nintendo Switch Online subscribers stream music from Nintendo games.

meme.bottom: zero tracks of the rage it caused
meme.take: Nintendo re-released the soundtrack of a thousand school bus arguments.
